computation.source_bars: prior trading day SIP 5m RTH bars
computation.zone: [price - zone_width, price + zone_width] (the level's own half-width; 0.40 floor)
computation.touches: count of 5m bars whose [low,high] intersects the zone
computation.flips: sign changes of (close - price) across consecutive RTH closes (rode-then-flipped)
computation.bounces: bar tests zone AND closes >= 1 zone-width away from it (rejection candle)

part3_spec.weight_upgrade: weight_effective = weight + 1 if touches>=2 else 0, +1 more if (flips>=1 or bounces>=1); binary threshold per the flat dose-response -- no deep-touch bonus

ab_prereg_sketch.harness: engine_fullhist_replay entry-layer variant: level-tied entries REQUIRE touch-validated trigger level (>=2 prior-day zone touches) vs baseline; plus fleet-parallel live arm pair (score-ladder pattern) for forward evidence
ab_prereg_sketch.gates: standard 4-gate (positive aggregate, day-majority, drop-best, held-out positive) + sub-window stability; primary metric = per-trade expectancy on the level-tied cohort; freeze via et_clock stamp before the run
ab_prereg_sketch.kill: if TV-gating drops level-tied n below ~40 in replay without raising $/trade, kill
